correctness.rationale: For nonempty finite (E equivalence,P unary) structures, each rank-one pointed type is determined by colour of a and set of quantum-free witness patterns (colour(b), a=b, E(a,b)); a rank-two sentence is a Boolean combination of existence of such pointed types. Each E-class red/blue population can be capped at 2 and the multiplicity of each resulting eight class types capped at 2 without changing these types, yielding exactly 3^8-1=6560 complete-profile representatives. From an independent fresh implementation of this rank-one signature, all 6560 were grouped into 207 distinct rank-two types; the minimum-size histogram for 1..13 was (2,6,10,17,22,28,30,29,26,18,12,5,2). Two extremal 13-point profiles were independently recovered: (1,1,1,0,0,1,1,1) and (1,1,1,0,1,1,0,1). The source also defines a separate recursive Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé type verifier, inspected but not treated as an independent formal proof. Uniform capping proves all finite structures are covered, not just the 6560 tested representatives.
